name: io.github.cyanheads/tvmaze-mcp-server
description: Search TVmaze shows, next episodes in your timezone, episode guides, daily TV schedules, and cast.

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: TVmaze API base URL. Override to point at an enterprise endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent sent on every upstream request. TVmaze asks that clients identify themselves. Defaults to the server name, version, and repository URL.

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone used when a tool call omits 'timezone' (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles').

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_DEFAULT_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used for tvmaze_get_schedule scopes 'linear' and 'all' when 'country' is omitted.

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_CACHE_TTL_S
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to hold an upstream response in the in-process cache. 0 disables caching.

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Concurrent upstream requests.

environmentVariables.name: TVMAZE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
